description: Verify an AI answer against real sources before anyone acts on it. Send a question; Oathlayer answers it, checks the answer against independent sources, and returns the answer, a state, a plain-language message (the tag), a color, and a permanent doc number anyone can verify free at oathlayer.com/verify. Tags: Verification Successful - Oath Approved (green); Verification Threshold Not Met (blue); Various Perspectives Apply (purple); Complex Question - Threshold Reserved; Clarity Needed to Continue (pink). Legal citations also get a citation tag: confirmed on official sources (green), found only on unofficial sites (blue), mismatched with the correct citation shown (coral), or not found in available sources (golden brown). Citation answers also include a short label: Confirmed, Unofficial, Mismatched or Not found. Oathlayer reports what happened; it does not judge right or wrong. Works on any topic and with any AI model. Costs one credit per completed check; errors and wrong keys cost nothing. Requires an API key from oathlayer.com. If a message starts with Oathlayer: then use this tool to check the question that follows. When showing the result to the user, always use exactly this layout, one item per line, as plain text with no bold: 'Question:' then the question that was checked, 'Answer:' then the answer from Oathlayer, 'Verification tag:' then the tag message, 'Doc ID number:' then the doc number. Do not add anything else, such as how many credits were used.

apiKey.description: Your Oathlayer API key from oathlayer.com. Only needed if the key was not added when connecting Oathlayer. Each completed check uses one credit.

question.description: The question to verify, in plain words (for a legal citation, include the full case name and citation). Spanish questions are supported.
